name: Upbit Listing Entry Bot
description: Scans Upbit listing notices, validates Bybit USDT perp availability, queues/executes pre-listing entries and sends listing alerts to Telegram.

name: Bybit Portfolio Hourly Alert
description: Sends Telegram snapshots with wallet balance, unrealized PnL, PnL %, and all open positions for a chosen Bybit account key.

name: experiment_v2 — 1H Wick-Reversal
description: 1H candle wick-reversal + volume spike + EMA(50) trend filter. ATR-based SL/TP, equity-% position sizing, frequency guard (2/hr per symbol). Bybit USDT-perp. Telegram alerts on open/close and 30-min updates.

name: experiment_v3 — 1-min ATR Trailing-Queue Scalper
description: 1-min candle 369 EMA alignment + volume spike. Posts a PostOnly limit order trailing TRAIL_OFFSET_ATR × ATR below/above mark. Transparently refreshes stale orders every 15s. ATR-based TP/SL (2:1 R:R). Max signal age 5 min. Bybit USDT-perp.

name: experiment_v4 — 1m/5m Dual-TF Scalp-Reversal
description: 1-min RSI(7)+Bollinger Band extreme + volume spike. 5-min EMA9/EMA21 trend gate. PostOnly limit entry with trailing stale-refresh (Bybit) or market entry (Bithumb). Native TP/SL on Bybit (ATR-based, 2:1 R:R). Bithumb: GTC TP limit sell + polled SL enforcement. 4% equity risk per trade. Target ≥10% net PnL/day.

name: experiment_v5 — Conservative Dual-TF Reversal
description: Built on experiment_v4 core with stricter risk caps: lower leverage, lower per-trade risk, fewer symbols, strict macro gate, and ATR-adaptive TP/SL targeting roughly 1-2% TP per trade.

name: experiment_v6 — Signal-Enhanced Market Making
description: Live order-book + trade-flow market making. Posts PostOnly bid+ask with ATR-spread and inventory skew. Token-bucket rate limiter (VIP 0: 8 ops/sec). Adverse-selection filter via ob_imbalance threshold. Native exchange TP/SL + daily drawdown + loss-streak circuit breakers. Note: at VIP 0 there is no maker rebate — consider experiment_v7 instead.

name: experiment_v7 — Signal-Driven Directional Scalp
description: Directional scalp driven by live WebSocket signals (ob_imbalance + trade_pressure_5m). Enters with market order when both signals agree. Native exchange TP (0.8%) + SL (0.4%) via set_trading_stop. Fee math: +0.725% net per TP win, -0.51% per SL loss, break-even win rate ≈ 41%. Cross margin, per-symbol leverage (5x BTC/ETH, 3x others). 30-min PnL+fee Telegram alerts + daily 10PM HKT summary.

name: experiment_v1 — Volume-Spike Momentum
description: 5-min candle volume spike (≥10%) + directional price move → open Long or Short on Bybit USDT-perp. Leverage 10×, $10 notional, TP +5%, SL −3%. Telegram alert on open/close and 30-min updates.
